13.critic_justification: Camera vision frames are processed and transmitted off-device to Gemini API for real-time AI music generation. WelcomeScreen.kt acts as a strict gatekeeper dialog requiring explicit user consent before enabling sign-in and main app access.

15.critic_justification: Audio recording is explicitly user-initiated via microphone button interaction in ChatInterface, transmitting PCM audio off-device to Gemini Live endpoint for voice commands. It is exempt from prominent disclosure but must be declared in Data Safety.

18.critic_justification: User email address is collected during user-initiated Firebase/Google authentication and displayed in profile UI. This collection is exempt from prominent disclosure but must be declared under Personal Info in the Play Store Data Safety section.
